This targeting is likely to influence the activity of other antibodies, such as cetuximab, which also interacts with the same target. The interaction between cetuximab and the Low affinity immunoglobulin gamma Fc region receptor III-A may be modulated by the presence of complement C1q subcomponent subunit C, suggesting a possible cross-talk between these molecules.
